items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 3 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: You had dinner at 8 pm or later 44.4% of the time, and sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones. Try to start dinner before 8 pm, as sugar rose 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 13.3 hours, with 40.0% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
